requirements.requirement: Determine the full name of the individual who was the third child out of five children born to a mother named Johanna and a father named Christian.
Establish that this individual, as a child, often hid away to immerse themselves in books.
Establish that this individual, as a child, crafted a candlestick out of clay so that they could read and learn in their secret spot at night.
Establish that at one point in this individual’s career they faced financial struggles and began taking on translation work to earn extra income.
Establish that this individual passed away wealthy sometime after 1820 but before 1880.
